user.title: Set up your heating plant
user.description: Heizzentrale starts in observe mode: it only measures and explains, it does not switch anything. Afterwards you add heat source, buffer tank, pump group, circuits and rooms one after the other. Only the name is required each time; everything else can be filled in later.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, for example "Heating" or the name of your house.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Used later for frost protection and for the evaluation. You can add it at any time.
Used later for frost protection and for the evaluation.

abort.already_configured: A plant with this name already exists.

user.title: Heat source
user.description: Step 1 of 5. Boiler, heat pump or any other device that produces heat. All sensors are optional.

data_description.name: For example "Pellet boiler".
data_description.kind: Only used for the picture and for later evaluation.
data_description.flow_entity: Temperature of the water leaving towards the heating.
data_description.status_entity: Any entity that shows whether the heat source is running.

user.title: Buffer tank
user.description: Step 2 of 5, only if you have one. A tank that stores hot water. Pick its temperature sensors from top to bottom.

data_description.name: For example "Buffer".
data_description.sensor_entities: The order you pick them in is the order shown in the picture: the first one is the top of the tank.
data_description.volume: Used later to estimate the stored energy.

user.title: Pump group
user.description: Step 3 of 5, only if you have one. The pump, with or without mixer, that pushes heating water into one or more circuits, for example into a manifold. When every circuit behind it is closed, it has nothing left to do.

data_description.name: For example "Radiator pump group".
data_description.flow_entity: Sensor behind the mixer: the temperature of the water going to the circuits.
data_description.return_entity: Sensor on the common return pipe.
data_description.status_entity: An entity that tells whether the pump is running.
data_description.control_entity: The entity that turns this pump group or its heating circuit on and off. A switch works, and so does a selection with modes such as off and auto. Heizzentrale does not switch it yet.

control_options.title: How is it switched?
control_options.description: {entity} has several modes. Tell Heizzentrale which mode turns the pump group off and which turns it back on. Nothing is switched yet; this is used once switching is enabled.

data_description.control_off_option: The mode in which this heating circuit does not heat.
data_description.control_on_option: The mode for normal operation, usually automatic.

error.same_option: Off and on must be two different modes.

user.title: Circuit
user.description: Step 4 of 5. One branch of your heating that can be opened and closed on its own, for example one floor on a manifold. If you have no branches, add a single circuit for the whole house.

data_description.name: For example "Ground floor".
data_description.system_type: One-pipe: radiators in a row on one pipe. Two-pipe: every radiator has its own flow and return. If you are not sure, keep two-pipe.
data_description.flow_entity: Sensor on the pipe going to the radiators.
data_description.return_entity: Sensor on the pipe coming back.
data_description.valve_entity: Switch or valve that opens and closes this circuit. Heizzentrale only reads it for now.
data_description.valve_type: Printed on the actuator: NC means closed without power, NO means open without power.
data_description.power_entity: Shows whether the actuator really draws power.
data_description.pump_group: The pump group that feeds this circuit. Leave empty if there is only one.

user.title: Room
user.description: Step 5 of 5. A room with a thermostat. Pick the thermostat; name and floor are taken from Home Assistant if you leave them empty.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name of the thermostat's area.
data_description.climate_entity: The climate entity that controls this room.
data_description.circuit: The circuit that supplies the radiators of this room. If there is only one circuit it is chosen for you.
data_description.floor: Leave empty: the floor is taken from the area of the thermostat in Home Assistant. Pick one only to override that.
data_description.window_entity: All windows and doors of this room. If one of them is open, the room is shown as open.
